messages.literal.name: Name
messages.literal.no_file: No file yet · Ctrl+S to save
messages.literal.local_maps: LOCAL MAPS — click to fill in the path
messages.literal.type_value: Type a value or path and press Enter. Ctrl+A selects all.
messages.literal.start_hint: Start drawing. F5 tests the map without saving.
messages.literal.draw_hint: Drag to paint. Right-click to erase.
messages.literal.stage_help: The first stage starts the campaign. Scroll to browse.
messages.literal.save_as_help: Save as creates a campaign that uses the same maps. Editing a map changes the shared file; use Save as in the map editor and Change map here to make a copy.
messages.literal.campaign_status: Choose stages, arrange their order and test with F5.
messages.literal.map_inspector: Select an object on the map or in the list to adjust its position and size.
messages.literal.body_size: The player body is 24×30. Object W/H define the interaction area.
messages.literal.issue_spawn: Exactly one start point (spawn) is required.
messages.literal.issue_goal: An exit (goal) is required to complete the level.
messages.literal.issue_size: Rooms in this profile must be 960×576 units.
messages.literal.issue_player_id: The ID player is reserved for the player.
messages.literal.issue_damage_respawn: respawn point is inside a damage zone.
messages.literal.issue_unsupported: starts in the air without immediate support.
messages.literal.issue_solid_target: fully blocked by solid tiles; projectiles cannot hit this target.
messages.literal.issue_blocked_pickup: fully blocked by solids or hazards; cannot be collected or activated safely.
messages.literal.issue_platform_end: platform destination is outside the room.
messages.literal.issue_platform_solid: platform path crosses solid tiles; test carrying and crushing.
messages.literal.issue_profile: Unsupported profile: use Combat or Adventure.
messages.prefix.need_object: This mode needs at least one object of type
messages.literal.map_new: New map. Choose Save to create a file.
messages.literal.no_preview: This editor host does not provide a test for this profile.
messages.literal.profile_help: Classic: jumps and crystals. Precision: dashes, walls and ladders. Rooms: doors and lifts. Combat: projectiles, targets and turrets.
messages.literal.search_cancelled: Search cancelled. F8 starts another check.
messages.literal.fix_test: Fix the reported errors before testing.
messages.literal.fix_save: Fix the errors before saving. The current map stays in the editor.
messages.literal.preview_start: Isolated test: F5 or Esc returns to the editor.
messages.literal.preview_end: Back in the editor. The test did not change the map or history.
messages.literal.resize_help: Enter width x height, for example 48 x 18.
messages.literal.shrink_warning: Tiles outside the new area will be cut. Objects are kept and validated. You can undo this.
messages.literal.solve_success: Solution confirmed. F8 can replay the route.
messages.literal.solve_uncertain: Search inconclusive: no complete route found.
messages.literal.campaign_unsaved_prompt: Save changes to the stage order?
messages.literal.remove_stage_prompt: Only the campaign reference is removed. The map file remains. You can undo this.
messages.literal.campaign_saved: Campaign saved. Maps remain in their own files.
messages.literal.valid_campaign: Structure valid. Test the sequence with F5.
messages.literal.structural_limit: Structural validation does not prove that every fight and route can be completed.
messages.literal.test_campaign_end: Test finished. Stage order and game saves were preserved.
messages.literal.campaign_preview_help: F5 / Esc: back · Enter: next stage after victory · F3: controls · P: pause
messages.literal.empty_campaign: Add Combat or Adventure maps to create your campaign.
messages.literal.delete_room_warning: Doors pointing to this room must be fixed. You can undo this.
messages.literal.open_condition_help: Cargo: requires all map plates. Exploration: requires collecting the double-jump ability.
messages.editor.caption: Platform2D 0.24 - Adventure Editor
messages.prefix.name: Name:
messages.literal.world_start_set: World start set at this entry.
messages.literal.switch_warning: Place a switch with T. Each condition can be added only once and an object cannot depend on itself.
messages.literal.replaying: Replaying the route under actual game rules…
messages.literal.geometry_search: Geometry validated. Searching for a playable solution…
messages.literal.geometry_manual: Geometry validated. Confirm the route with F5.
messages.literal.solution_rule: A solution requires every crystal and an exit on the same route.
messages.literal.adventure_solver: Adventure: flight and ledges are replayed; combat needs manual testing.
messages.literal.advanced_solver: Advanced profile: structural validation only; automatic solving is not yet available.
messages.literal.preview_solution_help: F5 or Esc: back to editor  |  Route confirmed with this level's physics and objectives
messages.literal.preview_help: F5 or Esc: back to editor  |  F3: configure test controls
messages.literal.issue_crate_overlap: crate overlaps a body or solid tile.
messages.literal.issue_crate_support: crate has no initial support; test the fall.
messages.literal.issue_plate_floor: place the plate base at floor level.
messages.literal.issue_plate_weight: not enough weight on the map.
messages.literal.issue_dynamic: This mode has dynamic rules: F8 is inconclusive; test the route with F5.
messages.literal.issue_precision: Precision profile: geometry checked; verify jumps, dashes, walls and ladders with F5. Automatic solving is only available for Classic.
messages.literal.issue_adventure: Adventure: F8 searches flight, platform and ledge routes. Combat still needs manual testing; an inconclusive search does not prove impossibility.
messages.literal.issue_combat: Combat profile: use F5 to verify jumps, crystal collection, shot range and target destruction. There is no automatic combat solver.
messages.literal.issue_world_exit: The world needs at least one final exit (goal).
messages.literal.issue_world_start: The world's starting room/entry does not exist.
messages.literal.issue_door_destination: door destination is missing or not linked.
messages.literal.issue_circular: conditions blocked; circular dependency or switch behind a closed door.
messages.literal.issue_world_no_exit: No final exit is connected to the starting room.
messages.literal.issue_world_switch: All final exits depend on switches that cannot be activated, even ignoring geometry.
messages.literal.issue_world_limits: Geometry and destinations checked. Connections do not prove a playable route: test doors, jumps and platforms with F5.
messages.literal.issue_room_crystals: not connected from the start; contains required crystals.
messages.literal.route_replay_failed: The candidate route failed exact replay. Result inconclusive.
messages.literal.route_too_far: beyond maximum jump/movement reach, even ignoring obstacles.
messages.literal.route_limit: No solution could be confirmed within the search limits. This does not prove the level is impossible.
messages.literal.route_exit_unconfirmed: The exit with all crystals has not yet been confirmed on one route.
messages.literal.adventure_no_replay: Candidate route found, but the host cannot replay it under actual game rules.
messages.literal.adventure_manual: Combat, crates, water, escape and acquired abilities need manual testing (F5). Search covers flight, platforms and ledges without enemies.
messages.literal.region_closed: region enclosed by solids, even ignoring body size and movement limits.
messages.literal.ledge_too_far: above/out of reach even with more permissive jump and ledge rules.
messages.literal.search_limit: Search limit reached. No route found does not prove impossibility.
messages.literal.replay_not_won: Candidate route did not win on actual replay. Test manually; this does not prove impossibility.
messages.literal.replay_death: Actual replay detected a death; the route was not certified.
messages.literal.search_review: Limited search found no confirmed route. Review access and test with F5.
messages.validation.classic_solved: Solution confirmed: {crystals} crystals and exit on one route, {seconds}s, no deaths.
messages.validation.classic_reset: Use R {count} time(s) to return to the respawn point.
messages.validation.adventure_solved: Route confirmed under game rules: {seconds}s, all objectives, no deaths. Use View solution to follow it.
